events.excerpt: Cesar Klein was not only an exceptional painter, but also created impressive stained-glass windows and ornate mosaics in Berlin. Many of his works have since disappeared, but his ideas live on.

events.name: Family Workshop | Gabriele Stötzer: Dabei sein und nicht schweigen
events.excerpt: For over five decades, Gabriele Stötzer has been exploring themes such as justice, self-determination and gender. Her own body often plays a central role in this – not as an object, but as a site of resistance and feminist self-assertion.

events.name: Guided Tour for Children and Families: “Of Water, Forests, and Meadows”
events.excerpt: How has nature shaped the lives of societies, and how have conceptions of nature changed over the past 800 years? This interactive guided tour, featuring creative hands-on activities and research tasks, invites families with children to…

events.name: Picture book cinema: Not only elephants in the house!
events.excerpt: There’s a lovely room for rent in the animals’ apartment block, and lots of prospective renters like it. But they all find fault with the neighbours – until someone arrives who sees everything differently.

events.name: A Flat for Rent
events.excerpt: “A Flat to Let” (Dira l’haskir) is a famous children’s classic by the Israeli author Lea Goldberg. In it, four animals living in a block of flats look for new neighbours and, in the process, learn about tolerance and acceptance.

events.name: Holiday workshop: From anti-asphalt watercolours to egg cartons
events.excerpt: Creative activities for children during the autumn half-term: equipped with drawing materials, handcarts and folding chairs, the children explore the area around the Berlinische Galerie together.

events.name: LEGO® Build the Change: Building the future together!
events.excerpt: Once a month, the library becomes a ideas lab!

events.name: Pokémon trading platform for children and teenagers
events.excerpt: Come along, bring your cards, play and swap them with others, and discover some new favourites.

events.name: Book Box and Song Journey: A reading and music session for babies and their carers
events.excerpt: Once a month, the Bibliothek am Wasserturm invites babies aged 0 to 3, accompanied by a parent, grandparent or childminder, to a special morning in our children’s library.

events.name: Muffin
events.excerpt: The play tells the story of a muffin who embarks on many adventures from a festively laid table. After encountering various animals, the muffin continues his journey and finds himself in many mysterious new worlds, where exciting surprises…

events.name: King, castle and guest room
events.excerpt: The New Chambers are situated in the heart of Sanssouci Park and were built under Frederick the Great. Large banquet halls and lavishly furnished living and sleeping quarters were intended for the King’s guests.

events.name: That's me!
events.excerpt: For centuries, people have used portraits to show who they are – or how they would like to be seen. Personal, staged, self-assured, or perhaps something quite different.

events.name: The Line Goes for a Walk
events.excerpt: Almost every painting begins with a drawing – then as now. In the Kupferstichkabinett, you’ll discover Baroque drawings that were created as templates for paintings or precious tapestries.

events.name: Made from plants! Making colors
events.venue: Haus Bastian – Zentrum für Kulturelle Bildung
events.excerpt: What shades of colour can be made from plants? What sort of colours can you find in the paintings at the museum? At Haus Bastian, you’ll explore how colours are made and what they’re made of, and learn how to extract dyes from plants.

events.name: Grandkids Time: Culture
events.excerpt: A cross-generational trip to the museum: this event gives grandparents and grandchildren the chance to explore together what Berlin was like in the past.

events.name: Tetrapak upcycling (Apprentice Weeks)
events.excerpt: Making purses out of Tetra Paks? Is that even possible? Yes! Amina will show you how. Come along and find out.

events.name: The adventures of the first female pilots
events.excerpt: The Adventures of the First Female Pilots: A reading and workshop on flying, combined with a treasure hunt through the Treptow Museum, for children aged 9 to 12.

events.name: Stars of the Stage: Picture-book cinema, Kamishibai & painting, crafts
events.excerpt: ‘Podesthelden’ is a programme for children aged 3 to 6. Here they can sing, paint, recite rhymes, do crafts and much more! Previously held at the Wasserturm Library.

events.name: Firebird
events.excerpt: The Gunniville Paper Theatre Berlin tells the story of an extraordinary friendship, narrated by Katharina and Anna Thalbach.

events.name: Snip it
events.excerpt: Craft workshop as part of the exhibition ‘KUNSTKNALL – Girl Power in Art’.

events.name: Stingrays, Muscle Power, and More—Harnessing Energy from New Ideas for the Future
events.excerpt: How will people generate energy in the future—and what will they even need it for? In this three-day vacation workshop at the Futurium Lab, you’ll have the chance to develop your ideas for the future!

events.name: Clay Monsters and Plaster Ghosts
events.venue: Haus Bastian – Zentrum für Kulturelle Bildung
events.excerpt: You’ll discover unusual and eerie creatures in the artworks on Museum Island. Do these creatures look familiar to you? Using clay and plaster, and a variety of tools and techniques, you’ll create your own wild or friendly monsters and…

events.name: Holiday programme: Mindful drawing
events.excerpt: This free two-day programme combines creative drawing with simple mindfulness exercises. It creates a calm, analogue space in which young people can learn to concentrate, relieve stress and strengthen their ability to express themselves.

events.name: Holiday programme: 2-day ‘Mindful Drawing’ workshop
events.excerpt: This free two-day programme combines creative drawing with simple mindfulness exercises. It creates a calm, analogue space in which young people can learn to concentrate, relieve stress and strengthen their ability to express themselves.

events.name: Kids’ Wednesday
events.excerpt: Come along to Children’s Wednesday at the KW. This creative space is designed for families with children aged 0 to 6 and offers a fun and inspiring environment in which to discover art together.
